topPRs.title: mise: bump bun, uv and semgrep
topPRs.author: pauldowman
topPRs.body:
The pinned bun and uv ship their own root stores, and both still trust the intermediate CAs from the [eMudhra key compromise](https://emudhra.we-have-a-problem.com/). That covers every bun `fetch` and every uv request made through the repo's mise toolchain, on developer machines and in CI. This includes mise's pipx-via-uvx installs of semgrep, slither and md_toc. Anyone holding one of the compromised keys could intercept that traffic with a certificate that doesn't appear in CT logs. With this change, both tools reject the advisory's no-CT test chains.

- The uv release chosen goes beyond the advisory's listed fix: as well as dropping the affected root, it rejects any chain containing the compromised intermediate keys.
- semgrep is bumped because the old pin is broken and only a stale CI cache was hiding it. Any `mise.toml` change invalidates the mise cache, and the fresh install resolves the old semgrep against the latest pydantic, which removed a function semgrep imports. That fails the contracts `check-fast` semgrep check with an ImportError. The new release works with the latest pydantic; it finds nothing with CI's exact command and passes all semgrep rule tests. #23594 makes the same bump.
- Go is out of scope; #23594 moves the mise pin and the Docker build images.
- Reviews: general review agents ran on each commit and found no issues. No repo reviewer agent's trigger matches a `mise.toml` pin bump. The security review hasn't run yet.
